message.content: The drive from San Francisco to Los Angeles is roughly 380–400 miles (about 610–640 km) along the I‑5 corridor. Under normal conditions—no major traffic, construction, or weather delays—a typical car can cover that distance in about **6 to 7 hours**. If you’re traveling during rush hour or on holidays, you might want to allow extra time.

We can provide approximate driving distance (~383 miles via I-5) and typical driving time (~6 hours). But we might also mention traffic, speed limits, etc. The user didn't ask for a tip calculation.
